entities.title: No person has play-tested it
entities.summary: The game's numbers (speeds, waits, how long the terns stay, how fast it gets harder) were chosen by the coding agent, and checked only by the automated tests and a look in a headless browser. No person has played it.
entities.impact: How hard the game is, and how it feels to play, are not known. The numbers in src/engine/rules.ts may want tuning once the first players have tried it.

entities.title: The best score stays on the device
entities.summary: The best score is kept in the browser's localStorage only. There is no high-score table and no check of a score by replay.
entities.impact: A best score cannot be compared with anyone else's, does not follow the player to another device or browser, and is gone when the browser's site data is cleared; a private window keeps none.

entities.title: One player, on one device
entities.summary: A game has one puffin and one set of controls; there is no second player, on the same device or online.
entities.impact: Friends cannot play together or against each other, except by comparing scores themselves.
